title: Grid
description: Responsive CSS grid: items auto-fit into columns from a minimum item width.

columns.description: How many columns to aim for. Each column has a minimum width, so the grid drops to fewer columns on narrow screens.

rows.description: Number of auto-height rows to lay out, for a grid that should not grow past them.

gap.description: Space between the cells, as any CSS length.

minWidth.description: Smallest a column may get before the grid wraps to fewer columns, as any CSS length. Overrides the width columns implies.

align.description: Vertical alignment of each item in its cell: start, center, end or stretch.

justify.description: Horizontal alignment of each item in its cell: start, center, end or stretch.

background.description: Background of the grid: a theme colour name (bg-primary, bg-secondary, bg-tertiary, primary, success, …) or any CSS colour. Never a var(--…) token (#907).

headers.description: Comma-separated header labels; each becomes a header cell at the top of the grid.

center.description: Centre every item in its cell, and its text. Bare attribute.

altRows.description: Shade every other row so rows are easier to follow. Bare attribute.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
_metadata.note: Expand by hand: enums, richer descriptions and accessibility notes cannot be read from source.
